comments.overrides.jose: firebase-admin -> jwks-rsa does a CommonJS require('jose'), but jose 6 is ESM-only. Vercel's serverless bundle loads firebase-admin as an external via native require, so that combination throws ERR_REQUIRE_ESM at import time and every /api/users request 500s. jose 5 ships a CJS entry point and exposes the same four APIs jwks-rsa uses (importJWK, exportSPKI, decodeJwt, decodeProtectedHeader). Drop this override once jwks-rsa switches to a dynamic import().
